text:
fix the timeout handling according to the requirement below
---
> all network requests must abort after thirty seconds
> retry with exponential backoff up to three attempts

update the schema validation to match the revised payload specification
---
> incoming orders must include tenant id and customer reference
> reject payloads missing either field with four hundred bad request

resolve the intermittent connection drop reported in production logs
---
> connection reset by peer on pool worker four
> socket idle timeout exceeded after sixty seconds

refactor the price calculation according to the business rule
---
> apply ten percent discount when order total exceeds one hundred
> round final currency values to two decimal places

implement the authentication token refresh policy below
---
> access tokens expire after fifteen minutes
> refresh tokens remain valid for seven days unless revoked

fix the cache invalidation race condition described in the issue
---
> stale product data returned after concurrent update
> cache key must be deleted before database commit

align the rate limiter behavior with the api gateway rules
---
> anonymous clients allowed sixty requests per minute
> authenticated clients allowed six hundred requests per minute

handle the database migration failure shown in the deployment log
---
> cannot drop column user id because foreign key constraint exists
> drop constraint before modifying table columns

implement the soft delete policy across customer records
---
> records must not be deleted permanently
> set deleted at timestamp and filter from standard queries

reproduce and fix the crash reported during batch export
---
> out of memory error during json serialization of large array
> stream rows directly to disk instead of buffering in memory

update password policy checks according to the compliance memo
---
> minimum length is twelve characters
> reject passwords found in the common breached list

adjust the worker queue concurrency according to load metrics
---
> queue backlog exceeds five thousand messages during peak hours
> scale worker pool from four to sixteen concurrent workers

enforce the data retention schedule defined by the security team
---
> audit log records older than ninety days must be archived
> purge raw request logs after fourteen days

correct the timezone conversion bug reported by international users
---
> daily summary report shows orders on the wrong calendar date
> store all timestamps in utc and format in user local zone

patch the security vulnerability flagged in the static analysis report
---
> potential cross site scripting in markdown rendering
> sanitize all rendered html before insertion into the dom

implement the webhook delivery retry schedule
---
> retry failed deliveries at intervals of one five and fifteen minutes
> mark delivery as permanently failed after three unsuccessful tries

reconcile payment records against the settlement statement
---
> pending settlement amount does not match ledger balance
> flag mismatched transaction identifiers for manual review

configure the circuit breaker parameters for the remote search service
---
> open circuit after five consecutive connection timeouts
> attempt probe request after thirty seconds in open state

rewrite the file upload validator to respect storage quotas
---
> maximum single file size is twenty megabytes
> reject files with extensions outside the permitted image list

update the telemetry exporter configuration as requested by ops
---
> batch metrics in groups of one hundred events
> flush metrics buffer every ten seconds or on process termination
